皇仁「超級狀元」吳同學表示，會留在香港選擇港大醫科，希望能在香港陪家人並且「對香港有歸屬感」，想為香港醫療出一分力。被問到成為「超級狀元」有何「貼士」，吳同學說：「鼓勵亦都建議未來同學多啲用 AI」，他分享 AI 能協助溫習，但對於目前 AI 日益強大並逐漸取代人類工作，吳同學認為，應該「用 AI 裝備自己」，AI 亦能成為協助醫療的工具，「應擁抱 AI」。

When asked about the "KOL intern doctor Angel incident," Wu said "interns should maintain professional ethics no matter what," and believed that the person involved should "reflect on their behaviour." The other two top scorers, Zhao and Tang, both said they are "born and raised Hongkongers," so they chose to stay in Hong Kong to develop their careers, and hope to contribute to Hong Kong's medical sector.

Apart from the joy of becoming a "top scholar," students who achieved their desired results also shouted "Got into university!" on the spot, sharing the joy with family and friends, as students and parents embraced each other.
